This display shows the definition of a type 3 font.
The following table explains the Display Source Overlay Font display and the
Display PFD Definition Font display.
Field Name
Description
Font number
Shows the font number.
Font type
Shows the font type (Code page and font character set)
Code page
Shows the code page name.
Font character set
Shows the font character set name.
Point size
Shows the point size.
Text
Shows the description of the font.
9=Set Initial Font
To change the definition of a font to the initial values, do the following on the
Work with Source Overlay Fonts display or the Work with PFD Definition Fonts
display.
1. Type 9 in the Opt. column beside the font number for which you want to
change the definition.
2. Press Enter.
